target.role: fresh whole-journey belonging and placement discovery for STRANGE GAIT
target.position: Whole journey: before the opener, between every non-protected pair, or after the tail. Preserve only Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer; Truth in Noise → Transparency remains available.
target.purpose: Test a current bass-techno within-track build, a current Brazilian grime/baile/electro mutation, a current Japanese fast electro-techno construction and an overlooked broken-beat-techno club edit against their strongest plausible lawful placements. Hard turns may pass when transition, local-run and long-form effects remain intentional; neither novelty nor constitutional neatness is enough.

sourceWindows: CURRENT / ADJACENT: https://pugilist.bandcamp.com/album/control — all four tracks on Sub Basics & Pugilist's 2026-07-17 Control EP were screened. The title track retained because the official exact-track note describes delicate melody and vocal ushering in thunderous kicks before low sub, modulating percussion and a gradual move toward more dancefloor-focused intensity.

CURRENT / NON-EUROPEAN / ADJACENT: https://ra.co/reviews/36339 and https://rhrmusiq.bandcamp.com/album/g-ria — all five tracks on RHR's 2026-03-06 GÍRIA EP were screened. CICLONADA retained because the exact-track review describes sub-bass and razor-edged drums ramping with vocals before mutating into electro and out-of-whack baile funk.

CURRENT / EMERGING / JAPAN: https://kwarp.bandcamp.com/album/the-6 — all three tracks on KWARP's 2026-02-22 The 6 EP were screened. The title track retained because the official exact-track note specifies dense tactile rhythms under restraint, a rail-shot pulse, electro backbone and 171 BPM.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / REWORK: https://deathandleisure.bandcamp.com/album/ritual-ep — all five club edits on Oliver Ho's 2025-10-31 RITUAL EP were screened. TERRA INCOGNITA (CLUB EDIT) retained because the official exact-track note identifies it as classic broken-beat techno from the Birmingham/Spanish lineage, presented as raw, relentless and propulsive.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: Jdotbalance's four-track 2022 High Exposure, Reptant's three-track 2026 Ballet Robotique, Forest Drive West's four-track 2026 Masking and Batu & Donato Dozzy's 2026 Exhale album/review were screened. Wilin', Ballet Robotique, Möbius and Exhale ranked below the four retained leads or overlapped recent artist/source territory.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 35 named tracks across eight current, adjacent/emerging and overlooked release/review windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Exact identities and primary discovery lanes retained in Runs 53–59 were not recycled.
The protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.

Batu & Donato Dozzy material was not retained because Batu had just supplied an exact selected candidate in Run 58 and the current scan produced stronger fresh artist lanes. Forest Drive West's Möbius was not retained because the Run 58 scan had just used Forest Drive West/Terrain as a primary lane.

No lead was promoted for recency, geography, historical status, label reputation, genre, novelty, structural cleverness or BPM. Energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Sub Basics & Pugilist — Control: strongest current exact-track structural build, explicitly moving from delicate material into an intensified dancefloor construction.
2. RHR feat. Logan_olm — CICLONADA: strongest current different-world mutation, explicitly transforming into electro and displaced baile funk.
3. KWARP — The 6: strongest current emerging high-speed electro-techno lead, with unusually specific official rhythmic and tempo evidence.
4. Oliver Ho — TERRA INCOGNITA (CLUB EDIT): strongest overlooked lineage lead, explicitly tied to classic broken-beat techno but supported by less within-track structural detail.
